name: Yamiyo ni Sasayaku ~Tantei Sagara Kyouichirou~
original_name: 闇夜にささやく ～探偵 相楽恭一郎～
source:
Anya ni Sasayaku: Tantei Sagara Kyouichirou (Eng. "Whisper in the Night: Detective Kyouichirou Sagara") is a mystery adventure game featuring detective Kyouichirou Sagara, and a sequel to Tsuki wa Kirisaku: Tantei Sagara Kyouichirou. This time, the mystery takes place on a luxury liner, when you are trying to solve the mystery behind the disappearance of girls on board the ship.

Unlike the typical visual novel style, you will have a bundle of new commands you will be able to use to search the locations more thoroughly. You can look around, talk to NPCs, check the items in your inventory, check the location map, or manually use cursor to look at interesting places and objects you can interact with while searching for clues.

[from [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/anya-ni-sasayaku-tantei-sagara-kyichir]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
《暗夜低语：侦探相良恭一郎》是一款悬疑冒险游戏，主角是侦探相良恭一郎，也是《月裂：侦探相良恭一郎》的续作。这一次，谜团发生在一艘豪华邮轮上，你必须查明船上女孩失踪的真相。

与典型的视觉小说形式不同，本作提供了一组新指令，让你能更加彻底地搜索场景。你可以环顾四周、与非玩家角色交谈、检查物品栏中的物品、查看地点地图，也可以手动移动光标，查看搜索线索时能够互动的地点和物品。

[来源：[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/anya-ni-sasayaku-tantei-sagara-kyichir]MobyGames[/url]]
